# MINERVA P&ID — Process-Logic Segmentation Report

**Project:** MINERVA CryoCell — Flow Schemes & Instrumentation  
**Standard basis:** ISA 5.1 instrument tags · ISO A3 sheet · color-coded line classes  
**Generated by:** `segment_pid.py` → `make_report.py`

This report segments every process-logic element extracted from the two source SVG P&IDs into the categories requested: process lines, equipment/components, instrumentation, vacuum barriers, temperature & pressure points, safety devices and color groups. All coordinates are in the shared SVG user space (`viewBox 0 0 1527.2727 1080`, ISO A3 landscape).

## 2. Process line segmentation (color-coded line classes)

Main process lines are segmented by their stroke color, which encodes the cryogenic line class. Specifications are taken from the drawing legend.

| Class | Color | Hex | Temp | Pressure | Segments (Q/RF) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | blue | #0000ff | 4.5 K | 3 bar | QCELL-LB:124 / RFCELL:32 | Supercritical / liquid helium supply (4.5 K, 3 bar) |
| B | cyan | #00ffff | 3.5 K | 27 mbar (spec 28 mbar) | QCELL-LB:78 / RFCELL:11 | 2 K / low-pressure helium return (3.5 K, ~27 mbar) |
| D | red | #ff0000 | 40 K | 14 bar | QCELL-LB:83 / RFCELL:5 | Thermal-shield / 40 K helium circuit (40 K, 14 bar) |
| E | olive | #808000 | 60 K | 13 bar | QCELL-LB:83 / RFCELL:2 | 60 K helium return / He-guard family (60 K, 13 bar) |

> **WATER** (green `#00ff00`) segments are coupler / DI cooling-water utility lines (to FREIA) and are tracked separately from the helium line classes.

**QCELL-LB** process-line segment counts: `A`=124, `B`=78, `D`=83, `E`=83, `WATER`=87

**RFCELL** process-line segment counts: `A`=32, `B`=11, `D`=5, `E`=2, `WATER`=27

## 4. Instrumentation segmentation (ISA 5.1 tags)

Tags are parsed as `<2-letter prefix><number>` and categorized by measured variable and instrument role. The first letter encodes the measured variable (T, P, L, F …); trailing letters encode the function (T = transmitter, V = valve, S = switch, etc.).

### QCELL-LB

| Prefix | Meaning | Variable | Role | Count |

| TT | Temperature Transmitter | temperature | sensor | 67 |

| CV | Control Valve | control | valve | 10 |
| PT | Pressure Transmitter | pressure | sensor | 9 |

| AK | Antenna / connector | mechanical | annotation | 2 |

| PL | Pressure Limiter | pressure | safety | 2 |

| RV | Relief Valve | safety | valve | 1 |
| HX | Heat Exchanger | process | equipment | 1 |
